## Prospect Desk
Set the hosted Supabase URL in **Workflow settings**. Assign an `x-research-key` Header Auth credential to **Lead research webhook** and all Supabase HTTP Request nodes. Assign a separate `Authorization: Bearer …` Header Auth credential to both Firecrawl nodes. Save the production webhook URL in the Supabase Edge Function secret `N8N_LEAD_RESEARCH_WEBHOOK_URL`.
